Four source files register a handler for `comment.created`. `comment-service.ts` publishes it with `emit("comment.created", …)`, so it is excluded.

- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` calls `subscribe("comment.created", …)` at line 198 and records an activity entry.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` calls `subscribe("comment.created", …)` at line 150 and reindexes the comment.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts` calls `subscribe("comment.created", …)` at line 203 and notifies the issue author and assignee. It attaches at module import and has no `register*` function.
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` calls `subscribe("comment.created", …)` at line 120 and enqueues webhook deliveries.

These files only declare or label the event name, so I excluded them:
- `src/types/event.ts`
- `src/types/activity.ts`
- `src/schemas/activity.ts`
- `src/schemas/webhook.ts`
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`

`src/server/services/event-registry.ts` wires the listener groups together but has no `comment.created` handler itself. Nothing else in `src` reaches the bus by another route: there are no `subscribeOnce` calls, and only `event-bus.ts` touches the handler map directly.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
